description: Reviews everyday Git porcelain plus local and remote operations that can discard work, replace history, refresh a remote Guard cannot verify, or read a staged index Guard cannot bound.
name: Git protection
saferAlternatives: Preview affected files and refs before destructive repository operations.
Create a temporary branch or stash before discarding local work.
Run fetch from the repository with a named origin instead of a URL remote.
Inspect the staged index with git diff --cached --check or lockfile excludes.
